name: Relative Path Traversal
principle: The product builds a pathname under a restricted directory from external input without neutralizing relative sequences such as "..". The resolved path can escape the intended directory and allow unauthorized read, write, delete, or code execution.
detection_signals: external input concatenated into fopen/open/stat/unlink/rename path with a base directory
request.getParameter() passed to new File(base, input) or Paths.get(base, input)
FileInputStream/FileOutputStream/Files.readAllBytes/Files.write called on a path built from an untrusted filename
ZipEntry.getName() or archive entry name passed to new File(destDir, name) without canonical containment check
filter removes only "../" or only "..\\" before file access
single-pass replace()/replaceFirst() removal of traversal tokens before file access
negative_signals: canonical child Path checked with child.startsWith(canonicalBasePath)
filename chosen from a server-side ID-to-path allowlist map
regex allowlist permits only basename characters and rejects '/' and '\\'
archive extraction validates canonical output path starts with canonical destination directory
false_defense_traps: denylist removal of "../" is bypassable by encoded, nested, or alternate separator forms
checking startsWith(base) before canonicalization misses base/../escape paths
filtering '/' but not '\\' fails on filesystems that accept both separators
decoding after validation or double decoding can introduce "../" after checks
web application firewall rules do not cover all file path input vectors
verification_focus: Can attacker-controlled relative path components reach a file operation without canonicalize-then-containment validation against the intended directory?

consequence_chains.trigger: relative traversal reaches a symlink inside the restricted directory
consequence_chains.consequence: restricted directory escape through the symlink target

consequence_chains.trigger: attacker controls upload filename and file contents
consequence_chains.consequence: write executable file outside the upload directory

consequence_chains.trigger: failed traversal path is returned in an error message

patch_principle: Accept only known-good filenames; reject directory separators and multiple dot components.
Decode once, then canonicalize to an absolute path before validation.
Verify the canonical child path is inside the canonical base directory using path-aware comparison.
Use server-side identifiers mapped to fixed paths instead of accepting raw path input.
For archive extraction, validate each entry path before creating or writing the output file.

minimal_examples.safe: Path p = base.toRealPath().resolve(file).normalize(); if (!p.startsWith(base.toRealPath())) throw new SecurityException();
